rationale: Despite a strong positive earnings catalyst and high relative volume, the current bid-ask spread is excessively wide at 31.8 bps ($2.11), which represents nearly 70% of a 5-minute ATR and imposes severe friction on entry. Furthermore, short-term price action is breaking below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($665.52) while still extended above session VWAP ($650.12), offering poor risk-reward for either a long continuation or a short against a dominant earnings uptrend.
